text:
leo (marketing): Team, planning the Adaptive Routing public announce for Apr week. Need final changelog URL, docs link, a 1-line benchmark blurb, and exact rollout window so we can schedule the blog + webinar.

maya (eng): Changelog PR up. Small opt-in API: `routing_policy` enum (latency | cost | hybrid). Non-breaking defaults. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/1001

rita (docs): Ill draft the docs page. Please paste the minimal curl/sample + migration note for pinned models.

maya (eng): Example for docs:
```
POST /v1/infer
{
  "model": "rwd-adaptive-v1",
  "routing_policy": {"type":"latency","fallback":"rwd-standard"}
}
```
Migration: pinned `rwd-standard` keeps old routing; set `routing_policy` to opt in.

evan (product): Marketing wants conservative bench numbers: p95 delta and cost delta with test context.

maya (eng): Internal perf (10k requests, seq=128): p95 125ms -> 104ms (~17%), est token cost -12%. Adding full run notes to PR.

omar (ops): Deploy plan: 2% canary in us-west for 4h, then 25% ramp if healthy. We can schedule docs to publish at canary start.

leo (marketing): Great. For the press banner: one sentence about latency, one about cost. Also need docs link live at canary start.

maya (eng): Draft press line: "Adaptive Routing cuts p95 inference latency by ~17% in typical web workloads and reduces per-token cost by ~12%."

rita (docs): Staging URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/adaptive-routing (will publish at canary start once PR merges).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled job #deploy-176800 for 2026-04-10T18:00:00Z. Canary: us-west-2 2% 4h.

leo (marketing): Webinar: Apr 13, 10am PT. Speakers: evan + maya + customer. Slides: bench, migration, canary. Ill post draft copy by EOD Thu. Please react with :eyes: when changelog/docs are merged.

omar (ops): Opening CRM webhook ticket to auto-tag early access leads. OPS #520.

maya (eng): Will ping when changelog merges.

leo (marketing): Thanks all. If timing shifts, call out here immediately. :sparkles:
